title: Framework-2 test A · induction, made by the bible (P18: assemble, formula, 30 s, dark, cinematic, silent)

captions.instagram:
Can motion create voltage? ⚡

Watch a coil, a magnet and a galvanometer build themselves, then move the magnet: in, the needle swings; still, it drops back to zero; out, it swings the other way.

Faraday's law: ℰ = −N dΦ/dt. The minus sign is Lenz's law: the induced current opposes the change.
No change in flux → no induced EMF.

Class 12 Physics · Electromagnetic induction
Asked in JEE Main, NEET and MHT-CET.
